title: Feathers v1: one theme editor -> Power BI json + Tableau json + Tableau tps
description: Goal: a Power BI or Tableau user builds one theme in the browser (colors, system fonts, gridlines, backgrounds), downloads files for their tool, and imports them by following the on-page guide, even as a first-timer. Static client-side site on GitHub Pages, no sign-in. Out of scope v1: custom fonts, per-visual Power BI overrides, accounts, playfair.com embed.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Power BI json imports in Desktop; palette, fonts, gridlines, backgrounds visible. 2) Tableau theme json imports via Format>Import Custom Theme, <15KB, schema-valid, fonts/gridlines/background/mark-color visible. 3) Tableau tps palettes (categorical/sequential/diverging) appear in Edit Colors. 4) Per-tool import guides: steps, exact path, verify check, common errors. 5) Colorblind + contrast checks, beginner/advanced toggle. 6) Static, sign-in-free, deployed to Pages.

title: Hand-verify guide wording and open Tableau questions against real UIs
description: Check against live apps and fix guides in src/guides/content.ts: (1) Power BI: Design ribbon > Import theme, the older View > Themes > Browse path, and Design > Customize theme > Colors. (2) Tableau: Format > Import Custom Theme, the Override/Preserve prompt's exact labels, Help > About Tableau. (3) tps: palette at BOTTOM of Edit Colors list; Sequential/Diverging palettes appear for continuous fields; Mac path Documents/My Tableau Repository. (4) worksheet-title and tooltip font sizes actually apply from a UI-generated theme (blogger reported they did not). (5) Published-workbook behavior on Cloud/Server (docs silent).

title: Editor UI: palette, typography (system fonts only), lines, backgrounds panels
description: Drag-reorder colors, palette type selector, curated font dropdown per tool, gridline/zeroline controls, background controls, View JSON.
design: Layout: controls left (collapsible panels) + preview slot right + bottom export bar; single column on phones; prefers-color-scheme dark mode. Panels: Start (3 presets + blank), Colors (categorical/sequential/diverging tabs, swatch rows with picker+hex, add/remove, reorder via drag AND up/down buttons, status+text roles), Fonts (confirmed per-tool lists + sizes), Lines (gridline/zeroline), Backgrounds. State: small observable store, no framework (embeddable), localStorage persistence wrapped in try/catch, no accounts. Tool toggle 'Editing for: Power BI | Tableau' switches font dropdowns/preview/highlighted exports; palette shared. Export bar shows all three files always, active tool's highlighted. File names: <slug>.powerbi.json, <slug>.tableau.json (slug sanitized to Tableau rule: alnum . - _ space), feathers-<slug>.tps plus Copy XML button (avoids overwriting user's Preferences.tps). ThemeError shown inline; export disabled with reason. Tests: Vitest for store/hex/slug/filename; drive app in browser for the flow; Playwright smoke in .10. Out of scope: previews(.6), a11y checks(.7), guides(.8), beginner/advanced(.9).
close_reason: Editor UI shipped. Evidence: 56/56 unit tests, typecheck+build clean, 50/50 real-browser checks (Edge) incl. downloaded files validated against both schemas, keyboard focus, drag reorder, persistence, 375px no overflow, dark mode computed styles; CI green on 130e799; live site loads with no console errors
